component.name: VPN Desk
component.summary: Browse through Tor from a country you choose

description.p: VPN Desk starts a bundled Tor client with a strict exit relay in the country you pick, shows your real and exit locations on a live map, and ranks countries by live speed estimates. No account and no subscription.

ul.li: Choose a country exit, or turn on Auto to always use the fastest location
Switch location without ever exposing your real IP
Live world map with animated pins for your real and exit IP
Optional system-wide mode that sends all TCP and DNS traffic from every app through Tor (asks for administrator permission once)
Tor is bundled, so there is nothing else to install

description.p: By default it is a local SOCKS5 proxy, so only apps that honour the system proxy are covered. Tor is slower than a commercial VPN and cannot carry UDP traffic.
See the release notes on GitHub for what changed.
